author: Play On Tabletop
description:
King of the Colosseum and official Play On Tabletop merch available from: https://merch.playontabletop.com/ 

The uprising continues in the Colosseum but the forces of the Ultramarines are here to put a stop to the uprising of the Genestealer Cults. WIll the Sons of Ultramar quell the uprising or will the Cults claim another Colosseum? Lists below

3 Colosseums Must Be Conquered! In order to be crowned King in this new season of King of the Colosseum a force must get a win in all three Colosseums: Jungle, Ocean, and Ruined City. However, one loss and the force is banished forever.
